title: Feature Request: Add Automation Container / Group feature to toggle multiple Automations together
body:
Description / Problem:
Currently AAPS uses separate automation rules for each task (e.g. profile switches, temp targets, SMB enable/disable). In complex setups with multiple training sessions, this leads to a large number of single automations, which makes the overview confusing and error-prone. It is also cumbersome to deactivate automations when a session is cancelled, as each rule must be toggled manually.

Proposed solution:
Introduce a concept like “Automation Container” or “Automation Group” to bundle several existing automations together. The container can be activated or deactivated as a whole, while the individual automations remain editable.

UI changes:

In the automation list, containers are displayed with expand/collapse
chekcbox for each container
Ability to create new containers and move automations in and out

Example use case:
Training Container “Morning Run”

Includes automations for:

Switching to a “Sport” profile 30 minutes before training
Lowering profile during the training.
Setting a higher temp target during training
Restoring the standard profile after training
Enabling or disabling SMBs depending on the phase

If the training is cancelled, simply deactivate the container “Morning Run” and all related automations are silenced at once.

Benefits:

Improved overview in complex setups
Easier management when sessions are cancelled or rescheduled
Lower error risk by reducing forgotten single automations
Cleaner structure and easier maintenance

comments.body: this is too complex for common use. and you can add more actions to a single automation. it should cover most of your request
